title: Margaret J NDE 5131
content: The light was green. It was a blind intersection with buildings on the corners, I got in the intersection, and there was a car one foot from my door. I felt a little anger that I didn't have time to scream. I thought, 'I don't want to die!' All the people I was close to flashed through my mind. I reached my hand out to brace myself on the dash, and realized I might lose my arm that way so I pulled my hand back. The car hit my driver's door, and the car spun, the back end finally hitting a pole (bless it!) as I was about to bash into the far door. (My boyfriend had talked me out of wearing my seatbelt a week before, told me it was going to get me killed.) I had flown to the safe side of the car. The car was still running - the noise of the wreck was so loud and violent - I heard the sound of silence, for the first time in my life. I thought to get out of the car and wanted very much to go to sleep but there was broken glass everywhere so I leaned against the building. A man came to me with a gash on his forehead and said, 'Are you alright.' I said, 'I guess so.' It was then I realized someone was in the car that hit me, and I felt forgiveness flow over me for this person. He went to call his mom and someone from their car asked if I wanted them to call an ambulance, I said yes. The next thing I knew I was jumping on the clouds, I thought this is great this is wonderful I don't care about all those people I left behind. It was so very beautiful. Years later, as I got to fly on a plane, I saw the same beautiful look of those clouds. Next thing I knew I started feeling pain, and thought, 'Oh no, I must be alive!' I was back in my body, the police were there, and the ambulance and about eighty people against the buildings watching the activity. I asked the man next to me if he would please get my shoe from the green car, and he went and got it. No one noticed me standing there with one shoe and cuts all over me I guess, I am glad so I wasn't interrupted in the clouds.

environment.environment_other_detail: She described being "jumping on the clouds" and noted "The light was green."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experience included a sudden shift to "jumping on the clouds" followed by pain and awareness of being back in the body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel/light-being/life-review described; cloud realm occurred after the accident and before return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported "The light was green" and hearing "the sound of silence" immediately after the crash; described the NDE realm as "jumping on the clouds."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "The next thing I knew I was jumping on the clouds, I thought this is great this is wonderful I don't care about all those people I left behind."; "Oh no, I must be alive!"; "The light was green."; "I heard the sound of silence, for the first time in my life."
